scope: Proposition 4.6 (Marked disk factorization) of the manuscript “The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4” (preprints/The-critical-Liouville-quantum-sphere-and-geometric-limits-of-FK-maps-at-q-equals-4-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For almost every prescribed positive initial perimeter pair, run the independent symmetric SLE0 κ(κ − 6) branch on the corresponding boundary-marked disk. At a fixed surviving trunk time t, conditional on the signed boundary-length path up to t, the offspring discovered by t are independent once-boundary-marked disks with perimeters equal to their absolute jump sizes. Their mark is the actual attachment or disconnection point. Independently, the remaining surface with its tip and target is a twice-marked disk conditioned on its two arc lengths. The assertion concerns abstract marked surfaces and retains the component laws of the unobserved CLEs.
